lifecycles.cto_community_takeover: Dev abandons, community assumes control, highly resilient
lifecycles.utility_grind: Dev builds real product, needs continuous marketing

vault_authority_models.description: Vault has NO authority. Once fees point here, it's locked forever. Best for ultimate market trust.
vault_authority_models.risk: If the project needs to migrate liquidity or contracts later, they can't stop the burn.

vault_authority_models.description: Vault has an authority (Dev). Dev can transfer authority to a Multisig. Allows Community Takeovers.
vault_authority_models.risk: Market sees 'Authority' and assumes dev can steal fees instead of burning them.

vault_authority_models.description: Burn is capped per hour. Prevents bots from front-running the burn or creating artificial mega-spikes.
vault_authority_models.risk: Requires more complex eBPF state management.

holdex_integration.requirement: Vault must expose total_burned and status on-chain
holdex_integration.badge_condition: Fee routing must be mathematically locked to the Vault PDA
